title: Watch Lindsay Clancy’s Murder Trial on Law&Crime
summary: Watch coverage of Clancy's murder trial live from Law&Crime as the high-profile Massachusetts case continues.
body_markdown:
Watch coverage of Lindsay Clancy’s murder trial from Law&Crime above as the high-profile Massachusetts case continues.


Clancy is on trial in Plymouth, Massachusetts, on three counts of first-degree murder in the 2023 deaths of her three children, Cora, Dawson, and Callan.


[True Crime Programming 24/7 channel created by Dan Abrams Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogLawCrimeChannel)


### Hear Law&Crime on SiriusXM


For more true crime and law-enforcement programming (but not live coverage of the Clancy trial), tune in to[Law&Crime on SiriusXM](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/law-crime-channel) .


Founded by legal analyst and attorney Dan Abrams, the channel features true-crime and law-enforcement programming, including in-depth bodycam footage and original series. Law&Crime is available on SiriusXM channel 793 in the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogLawCrimeChannel) .
